1. COMPANY OVERVIEW

Q: What is Ranking Matters?
A: Ranking Matters is a performance-driven Local SEO and Digital Optimization agency based in Thokar Niaz Baig, Lahore, Pakistan.

Q: When was Ranking Matters founded?
A: Ranking Matters was founded in 2024 and has quickly grown into a trusted name for local businesses in Lahore.

Q: Where is Ranking Matters located?
A: Our office is based in Thokar Niaz Baig, Lahore, Pakistan. While we are physically located in Lahore, we help businesses across Pakistan improve their local search presence.

Q: What is the main goal of your agency?
A: Our main goal is simple: to help local businesses claim top visibility on Google Maps and turn their Google Business Profiles into high-converting lead generation machines.

Q: What are the core values of Ranking Matters?
A: We believe in making data-driven decisions, providing transparent reporting, staying results-focused, and always putting client success first.

------------------------------------------------------------

2. CORE SERVICES

Q: What services does Ranking Matters offer?
A: We offer Google Business Profile Optimization, GMB Suspension & Recovery, Local Citation Engineering, Google Maps Ranking, Google Maps Marketing, and Landing Page Design.

Q: How do you handle Google Business Profile (GBP) Optimization?
A: We do complete structural builds and monthly optimizations. This includes keyword category structuring, geo-targeted asset stacking, and continuous audits to help your profile securely enter the Google 3-Pack.

Q: What happens if my GMB profile gets suspended? Can you help?
A: Yes, absolutely. We provide emergency restoration services for suspended accounts. We clean up contaminated data, audit your documents, and use direct Google Support pipelines to get your profile reinstated as quickly as possible.

Q: What is Local Citation Engineering?
A: It's a process where we build tier-1 business citations for you while fixing historical NAP (Name, Address, Phone) variations. This ensures your business data is consistent everywhere on the web.

Q: How do you improve Google Maps Rankings?
A: We use advanced georadial mapping, proximity optimization, and multi-location strategies to help your business reach the top positions in local search results.

Q: What is included in Google Maps Marketing?
A: We help drive targeted traffic and leads to your business through review generation strategies, photo and video optimization, and proper management of your Google Posts.

Q: Do you design landing pages?
A: Yes, we design custom, hyper-local landing pages that are focused purely on conversions. They include Schema markup implementation, are mobile-responsive, and load fast.

------------------------------------------------------------

3. INDUSTRIES & PRICING

Q: Which industries does Ranking Matters specialize in?
A: We primarily work with HVAC & Mechanical, Emergency Plumbing, Home Contracting & Roofing, Premium Bridal Studios, Commercial Janitorial Services, and Real Estate Brokerages.

Q: How much do your services cost?
A: Our pricing is flexible and customized based on each client's specific business needs, goals, and market competition. We offer tailored packages ranging from Starter to Enterprise levels to ensure you get the best ROI. Please contact us directly for a custom quote.

Q: Do you require long-term contracts?
A: No, we don't believe in locking people in. All our campaigns run on flexible month-to-month commitments based on transparent performance and verifiable ROI.

------------------------------------------------------------

4. TECHNICAL EXPERTISE & FAQs

Q: What technical skills does the Ranking Matters team have?
A: Our team is highly skilled in GMB Troubleshooting & Verification, Georadial Proximity Optimization, Local JSON-LD Semantic Web, and Directory Data Remediation (NAP Cleanup).

Q: What SEO tools do you use for your work?
A: We use industry-standard tools, including Ahrefs Pro, Semrush Matrix, Screaming Frog, and BrightLocal.

Q: What are the most common causes of GMB suspensions?
A: The most common causes include aggressive name changes (keyword stuffing), address changes to unverified locations, data mismatches across directories, and system sweeps targeting specific local service categories.

Q: How long does GMB suspension recovery take?
A: The timeline varies depending on the type of suspension (soft vs. hard). However, our specialists use proven documentation and direct pipelines to expedite the reinstatement process as quickly as possible.

Q: Where can I read your guides about Local SEO and Google Maps?
A: We have a dedicated blog section on our website where we publish detailed guides and step-by-step tutorials.
